item.title: President Lee on demands to 'declare he will not run for a second term'... "It's like being told to say you won't steal" (李 ‘연임 불출마 선언’ 요구에... “도둑질 안 하겠다 말하라는 격”)
item.description:
President Lee on demands to 'declare he will not run for a second term'... "It's like being told to say you won't steal" (李 ‘연임 불출마 선언’ 요구에... “도둑질 안 하겠다 말하라는 격”)

President Lee reportedly responded to demands to "declare he will not run for a second term" on the 4th with remarks to the effect of, "It's like being asked to say you won't steal—do I really need to say such a thing?" This is interpreted as meaning that under the current Constitution, even if it were amended, a sitting president would not be allowed to serve a second term, so there is no need to explicitly state a position. (이재명 대통령이 4일 ‘연임 불출마를 선언하라’는 요구에 대해 “도둑질은 안 하겠다고 하라고 하는 것과 같은 것인데 그런 말을 굳이 해야 하나”라는 취지의 말을 한 것으로 알려졌다. 현행 헌법상 개헌을 해도 현직 대통령의 연임은 허용되지 않으니 굳이 입장을 밝히지 않겠다는 뜻으로 해석된다.)

At a meeting with civic groups held at the presidential office (Cheongwadae) that day, President Lee reportedly received a question from a participant asking whether it might be better to "more explicitly state that he will not seek a second term," and replied to the effect of, "The public and the National Assembly wouldn't accept it anyway, so why bother saying it?" The opposition and others have been demanding that President Lee declare he will not run for a second term to prove the sincerity of his push for a constitutional amendment. In response, the presidential office has maintained the position that under the current Constitution, even a constitutional amendment would not permit a sitting president to serve a second term, and that there is no need for President Lee to personally make such a statement. <<> Additionally, at the same meeting, President Lee reportedly said regarding the issue of dispatching troops to the Strait of Hormuz, "We are taking this seriously." The remark reportedly came in response to a participant's statement that "troop dispatch is a serious matter and must never be done." President Lee reportedly said, "Currently, to ensure the safe navigation of our merchant vessels, the UK and France are sending warships separately from the United States. If we also send warships, it could appear as though we are joining the war, and nothing has been decided (regarding troop dispatch)." <<> President Lee also reportedly expressed frustrations related to his declining approval ratings. In his opening remarks, President Lee reportedly encouraged participants, saying, "I believe this is the first time we are meeting with leaders and activists of civil society organizations since December 2024 (when martial law was declared). You have all been through a lot." He then added, "In the early days of my presidency, things were hectic with various matters, and it was difficult to hear your views in detail. Today, I will listen carefully to what you have to say." <<> The meeting that day was originally scheduled for one and a half hours, but as various agenda items came pouring in—including the issue of troop dispatch to the Strait of Hormuz—it lasted three and a half hours. Attendees at the event included Lee Seung-hoon, operating committee chairman of the Citizens' Organizations Solidarity Conference, and Ju Je-jun, policy committee chairman of the Korea Progressive Solidarity, as well as representatives from progressive civic groups such as Lawyers for a Democratic Society, Citizens' Coalition for Economic Justice, the Korean Peasants' League, the Institute for Korean Historical Studies, the National Alliance of Democratic Street Vendors, the Autonomous Unification and Peace Alliance, the National Women's Association, and the Korean Women's Associations United. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 시민단체와의 간담회에서 참석자로부터 ‘연임을 안 하겠다고 좀 더 명시적으로 얘기하는 게 어떻겠느냐’는 질문을 받고 “국민도 국회도 안 받아들일 텐데 (그런 말을) 뭐 하러 하느냐”는 취지로 답했다고 한다. 야당 등은 개헌 추진의 진정성을 입증하려면 이 대통령이 연임 불출마를 선언해야 한다고 요구 중이다. 이에 청와대는 현행 헌법상 개헌을 해도 현직 대통령은 연임이 허용되지 않으며, 굳이 이 대통령이 직접 이 같은 얘기를 할 필요는 없다는 입장을 밝혀왔다.)

item.title: Genencell Founder and Broker's 'Hundreds of Billions in Investment Attraction' Big Picture—Did Kim Seung-won Know? (제넨셀 설립자·브로커 ‘수백억 투자유치’ 큰 그림, 김승원 알았나)
item.description:
Genencell Founder and Broker's 'Hundreds of Billions in Investment Attraction' Big Picture—Did Kim Seung-won Know? (제넨셀 설립자·브로커 ‘수백억 투자유치’ 큰 그림, 김승원 알았나)

Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, has said that his request to the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) to approve pharmaceutical company Genencell's COVID-19 drug clinical trial, made at the behest of an acquaintance, a female broker surnamed Yang, was a "simple relay of a public-interest complaint." However, claims emerged on the 4th that Kim told Yang, "If the MFDS approves it, you could make hundreds of billions of won." Yang was also found to have asked Kim for help while stating, "300 billion won in investment has already been secured for Genencell." <<> The opposition has pointed out, saying, "It was a case where Kim was brought in for lobbying the MFDS for approval by 'operators' whose goal was attracting external investment from the start," adding, "Kim's explanation that this was a public-interest complaint is hard to accept." <<> ◇Kim Seung-won: "If MFDS Approves, Hundreds of Billions of Won" <<> According to prosecution investigations, Genencell founder and university professor Kang repeatedly proposed to Yang, who attended the same graduate school, starting in September 2021, saying, "If you help get the clinical trial approved through a political figure, I'll provide financial support as well." <<> According to a recording released that day by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, on September 14 of that year, Yang asked Kim to expedite MFDS clinical approval for Genencell, saying, "(If approval is granted,) that company will become the COVID company, and it would also be good for next year when you run for election." She also described Genencell founder Kang as "someone who, if he becomes the head of a listed company and cash flow becomes smoother, could be a source of strength for you." On October 7, during a call with Yang, Kim said, "The moment the MFDS approves it, you can make hundreds of billions of won, and that's why there's fierce lobbying (among pharmaceutical companies). I need to hear the details, so send me the materials by email." <<> That same day, Yang emailed Kim the drug development status materials, and five days later, on October 12, Kim told then-MFDS Commissioner Kim Gang-lip, "Please ask the working-level staff to process (the clinical trial approval) quickly." <<> Kim's side has stated, "We judged that Yang's grievance had public-interest merit and (relayed it to the MFDS commissioner)." In response, lawmaker Han Dong-hoon said, "Kim was also aware in advance that Genencell was slated to receive investment depending on whether clinical approval was granted." In other words, it was private-interest lobbying, not a public-interest complaint. <<> ◇Average 71 Days for New Substance Clinical Trials, 33 Days for Genencell <<> Suspicions have also been raised that immediately after Kim's call on October 12, 2021, then-MFDS Commissioner Kim Gang-lip pressured the responsible working-level staff. People Power Party lawmaker Park Jung-hoon stated, "Commissioner Kim sent text messages berating the clinical trial approval staff, asking, 'Do you want me to hear that kind of thing from a lawmaker?'" Commissioner Kim relayed to Kim Seung-won, "Lawmaker, regarding the Genencell matter you were concerned about, I've passed it on to the working-level staff to handle properly." Two weeks later, the MFDS approved Genencell's clinical trial plan. <<> According to the 'COVID-19 Treatment Clinical Trial Approval Status' that People Power Party lawmaker Han Ji-ah's office obtained from the MFDS, between 2020 and 2022, 21 new substance-based COVID-19 treatment development projects took an average of 71 days to receive approval. In contrast, Genencell received approval in just 33 days under the same new substance-based conditions. That means approval was more than twice as fast. <<> ◇Pharmaceutical Founder Sold Stocks Right Before MFDS Approval <<> Genencell founder Kang sold 660,000 of his own shares for approximately 6.3 billion won to KOSDAQ-listed company Sejong Medical on October 19, 2021, just before the MFDS approval was granted. Sejong Medical also acquired roughly 5 billion won worth of convertible bonds issued by Genencell. As a result, Genencell's largest shareholder changed from Kang to Sejong Medical. <<> On October 27, when Genencell announced the clinical trial approval, Sejong Medical's stock price fluctuated wildly. It surged more than 15% at one point, then hit the daily lower limit on the same day as massive sell-offs occurred. During the prosecution investigation, it was revealed that Genencell had submitted false data to the MFDS when requesting approval of its clinical trial plan, with suspected side-effect cases such as experimental animals (hamsters) dying having been deleted. Genencell founder Kang, indicted on charges including breach of trust, was sentenced to three years in prison with a five-year suspension in the first trial in December 2024. <<> Genencell has currently temporarily suspended its clinical trial plan. The book value of the Genencell stake that Sejong Medical bought for approximately 6.3 billion won became 'zero won' at the end of 2022. A whistleblower A, familiar with internal circumstances, stated in an opinion submitted to the court, "About 700 small shareholders of Sejong Medical, whose families have been broken and livelihoods destroyed by this case, are calling for severe punishment of the defendants (Kang, Yang, and others)." <<> ◇Drunk Driving and Unpaid Fines Controversy Also Emerge <<> The fact that Kim received a fine of 700,000 won for drunk driving in July 2008 while working as a lawyer is another point of controversy. Additionally, it was revealed that Kim's vehicle was seized three times for failing to pay parking and stopping violation fines. Kim apologized, saying, "Drunk driving is an unforgivable mistake for any reason." (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자는 지인인 여성 브로커 양모 씨의 부탁을 받고 식품의약품안전처에 제약사 제넨셀의 코로나 신약 임상시험 승인을 청탁한 데 대해 “공익적 민원의 단순 전달”이라고 했다. 하지만 김 후보자가 양씨에게 “식약처가 승인할 경우 수천억 원을 벌 수 있다”고 했다는 주장이 4일 나왔다. 양씨 또한 “제넨셀에 300억원 투자가 유치되어 있다”면서 김 후보자에게 청탁했던 것으로 조사됐다.)

item.title: Opposition Rallies to Shield Kim Seung-won... Turns Instead to Striking at Han Dong-hoon (與, 김승원 엄호 총력… 되레 한동훈 때리기)
item.description:
Opposition Rallies to Shield Kim Seung-won... Turns Instead to Striking at Han Dong-hoon (與, 김승원 엄호 총력… 되레 한동훈 때리기)

The Democratic Party of Korea has moved to shield Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, who has faced allegations of lobbying for COVID-19 drug approval. The party has characterized the case as a "political prosecution's fabricated investigation under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration" and emphasized that he received a suspended indictment from the prosecution. At the same time, they have taken aim at independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who has been leading the allegations against nominee Kim, asking, "How did he obtain the indictment and investigation records for this case?" Rather than refuting the relationship between nominee Kim and broker Mr. Yang, they have opted to attack lawmaker Han instead. <<> Cho Kye-won, a spokesperson for the Democratic Party, said in a书面 briefing that day, "Lawmaker Han is making baseless claims, throwing around talk of a special prosecutor against nominee Kim," and called it "black propaganda that degrades the National Assembly's constitutionally granted authority to vet personnel nominations into a tool for personal media play in order to sustain his political relevance." Since nominee Kim was named, lawmaker Han has repeatedly raised suspicions, claiming that "the Western District Prosecutors' Office originally planned to indict nominee Kim over the food and drug safety agency lobbying case," and has disclosed phone records between broker Mr. Yang and nominee Kim. Han previously served as Minister of Justice under the Yoon Suk-yeol administration. <<> Seo Young-kyo, a Democratic Party lawmaker and chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, also said on YTN radio that day, "How did these investigation records leak out, and now lawmaker Han is waving them around again?" adding, "This kind of behavior is wrong." She also stated, "The prosecutors who distort things are the bad ones," and emphasized, "Nominee Kim has not even been indicted." Nominee Kim and some Democratic Party lawmakers have framed the act of asking the head of the food and drug safety agency about drug approval as "resolving civil complaints raised by the public." <<> Lee Geon-tae, a key pro-Lee Jae-myung lawmaker, also held a press conference at the National Assembly that day to vigorously defend nominee Kim. Lee, who has been at the forefront of efforts to have the indictment against nominee Kim and the president's case withdrawn, said, "This case was the Yoon Suk-yeol regime's political prosecution abusing investigation and indictment as tools to eliminate political rivals and maintain power," adding, "For three long years, 11 prosecutors were deployed, and when nothing turned up, the prosecution itself issued a non-indictment decision." He continued, "An apology for the atrocities of Yoon's political prosecution should come first." (더불어민주당이 ‘코로나 신약 승인 로비 의혹’이 제기된 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자를 엄호하고 나섰다. 이 사건을 ‘윤석열 정부 정치 검찰의 조작수사’로 규정하고 검찰에서 기소유예 처분을 받았다는 점을 강조했다. 그러면서 김 후보자 의혹 제기를 주도하고 있는 한동훈 무소속 의원을 향해 “어떻게 이 사건 공소장과 수사기록을 입수했나”라고 했다. 김 후보자와 브로커 양씨와의 관계 등에 대해선 반박하지 않고 한 의원 때리기에 나선 것이다.)

item.title: Lee Courts the 'Left,' Invites Progressive Groups to Cheong Wa Dae for Meeting (‘왼쪽’ 챙기는 李, 진보단체들 불러 청와대서 간담회)
item.description:
Lee Courts the 'Left,' Invites Progressive Groups to Cheong Wa Dae for Meeting (‘왼쪽’ 챙기는 李, 진보단체들 불러 청와대서 간담회)

President Lee Jae-myung will make a state visit to France for five days and three nights from the 6th to the 9th, local time. National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said at a briefing at the Cheong Wa Dae Chun Choo-gwan on the 4th, "This visit follows President Emmanuel Macron's invitation for President Lee to serve as co-chair of the 'Lumière Summit,' an international film and video summit, during his state visit to Korea last April." (이재명 대통령이 현지 시각 6일부터 9일까지 3박 5일 동안 프랑스를 국빈 방문한다. 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 4일 청와대 춘추관에서 브리핑을 통해 “지난 4월 국빈 방한한 에마뉘엘 마크롱 대통령이 이 대통령을 국제 영화·영상 정상회의인 ‘뤼미에르 서밋’ 공동 의장으로 초청한 데 따른 방문”이라고 밝혔다.)

After arriving in France on the 6th, President Lee will attend the Lumière Summit in Saint-Paul-de-Vence, southern France, on the following day, the 7th, as co-chair alongside President Macron. He will also carry out a state visit itinerary in Paris for two days starting on the 8th. At the summit meeting with President Macron on the 8th, the dispatch of troops to the Strait of Hormuz could also be on the agenda. The two leaders agreed at the Korea-France summit last April to cooperate in securing safe maritime transport routes through the Strait of Hormuz. (이 대통령은 6일 프랑스에 도착한 뒤 이튿날인 7일 프랑스 남부 생폴드방스에서 열리는 뤼미에르 서밋에 마크롱 대통령과 공동 의장 자격으로 참석한다. 또 8일부터 이틀간 파리에서 국빈 방문 일정을 소화한다. 8일 마크롱 대통령과의 정상회담에서는 호르무즈 해협 파병도 의제가 될 가능성이 있다. 양 정상은 지난 4월 한·프랑스 정상회담에서 호르무즈 해협 내 안전한 해상 수송로를 확보할 수 있도록 협력하기로 한 바 있다.)

Following the summit, President Lee will attend the "Korea-France Business Roundtable" with participation from around 20 companies from both countries. That evening, he will attend a state dinner hosted by President Macron and his wife at the Élysée Palace. On the final day of the visit, the 9th, he will hold a luncheon meeting with Korean residents in France. (이 대통령은 정상회담 후 양국 기업 20여 곳이 참여하는 ‘한·프랑스 비즈니스 라운드테이블’에 참석한다. 같은 날 저녁에는 마크롱 대통령 부부가 엘리제궁에서 주최하는 국빈 만찬에 참석한다. 방문 마지막 날인 9일에는 프랑스 동포들과 오찬 간담회 등을 갖는다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee invited leaders of civil society organizations to Cheong Wa Dae for the first time since his inauguration on the 4th. At the meeting, President Lee said, "In the early days of my administration, it was difficult to fully hear the voices of civil society amid various pending issues." This came after he recently said he would "pay more attention to the left," having held an emergency meeting with the chairmen of the two major labor federations the previous day, and now meeting with officials from progressive groups. President Lee stated, "The world you want or seek to create is unlikely to differ greatly from the world I want to create," adding, "In the social reforms we need to pursue going forward, civil society organizations will play a very significant role." He also said, "The paths and methods to reach our goals may differ somewhat, but I believe those differences are not significant." (한편 이 대통령은 4일 취임 후 처음으로 시민사회단체 인사들을 청와대로 초청했다. 이 자리에서 이 대통령은 “취임 초기 여러 현안으로 시민사회의 목소리를 충분히 듣기 어려웠다”고 했다. 최근 “왼쪽을 좀 더 챙기겠다”고 하면서 전날엔 양대 노총 위원장과의 긴급 만남을 가진 데 이어 이날도 진보 성향 단체 관계자들과 만나 이같이 말한 것이다. 이 대통령은 “여러분이 원하거나 만들고자 하는 세상과 제가 만들고 싶은 세상이 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라며 “앞으로 우리가 해야 할 사회 대개혁에서도 시민사회단체들의 몫은 매우 크다”고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 “목표에 이르는 경로와 방식이 조금씩 다를 수 있겠으나 그 차이는 크지 않다고 생각한다”고도 했다.)

Attendees at the meeting included Lawyers for a Democratic Society, the Citizens' Coalition for Economic Justice, the Secretary-General of the Korean Peasants League, the Institute for Research in Collaborationist Activities, the Alliance for Korea's Reunification and Peace, and the Korean Progressive Solidarity, among others. (간담회에는 민주사회를위한변호사모임, 경제정의실천연합, 전국농민회총연맹 사무총장, 민족문제연구소, 자주통일평화연대, 한국진보연대 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Yong Hye-in, Receiving State Subsidies, Said Six Years Ago: "Abolish State Subsidies That Nurture Parasite Parties" (국고보조금 받는 용혜인, 6년전엔 “기생충 정당 키우는 국고보조금 없애야”)
item.description:
Yong Hye-in, Receiving State Subsidies, Said Six Years Ago: "Abolish State Subsidies That Nurture Parasite Parties" (국고보조금 받는 용혜인, 6년전엔 “기생충 정당 키우는 국고보조금 없애야”)

Yong Hye-in, the nominee for Minister of Gender Equality and Family, has been found to have compared political parties receiving state subsidies to "parasites" six years ago and advocated for abolishing those subsidies. However, once nominated as a minister candidate, Yong has indicated she will not resign her proportional representative seat in order to maintain the Basic Income Party's state subsidies. The People Power Party said on the 4th, "The Basic Income Party is no different from a parasite party." (용혜인 성평등가족부 장관 후보자가 6년 전 국고보조금을 받는 정당을 ‘기생충’에 비유하며, 보조금 폐지를 주장했던 것으로 나타났다. 하지만 정작 용 후보자는 장관 후보자로 지명되자 기본소득당의 국고보조금을 유지할 목적으로 비례대표 의원직을 사퇴하지 않겠다는 뜻을 밝힌 상태다. 국민의힘은 4일 “기본소득당이야말로 기생충 정당과 다름없다”고 했다.)

The Basic Income Party held a press conference in February 2020 and argued, "Abolish state subsidies that mass-produce parasite parties." In a photo parodying the poster of the film *Parasite* at the time, Yong was seen holding a placard reading, "Abolish state subsidies and introduce political basic income." (기본소득당은 2020년 2월 기자회견을 열고 “기생충 정당 양산하는 국고보조금 폐지하라”라고 주장했다. 당시 영화 기생충 포스터를 패러디한 사진에서 용 후보자는 “국고보조금을 폐지하고 정치 기본소득을 도입하라”는 내용의 팻말을 들고 서 있었다.)

Yong has maintained that she will keep her proportional representative seat even if appointed as minister. The reason was that, having been elected as a proportional representative for the Democratic Party's satellite party, if she stepped down, the seat would go to the next in line from the Democratic Party, and the Basic Income Party, holding just one seat, would become an outside-the-National-Assembly party. The Basic Income Party, founded in 2020, received around 10 million won per quarter in state subsidies until last year, and in the third quarter of this year received subsidies of 277.09 million won for the first time—approximately 1.1 billion won annually. Criticism has also come from the ruling camp, asking, "Now that you receive more state subsidies, have you changed your mind?" Yong remained silent on the day when asked whether she had any intention of resigning her parliamentary seat. (용 후보자는 장관에 임명이 되어도 비례 의원직을 유지하겠다고 해왔다. 민주당 위성정당 비례대표직에 당선됐기 때문에 자신이 그만두면 후순위 비례직을 민주당이 가져가고, 그에 따라 1석인 기본소득당이 원외정당이 된다는 이유에서였다. 2020년 창당한 기본소득당은 작년까진 분기당 1000만원 안팎의 국고보조금을 받다가 올해 3분기 처음으로 2억 7709만원의 보조금을 받았다. 연간 약 11억원이다. 여권에서도 “국고보조금을 많이 받으니 생각이 바뀐 것이냐”는 비판이 나왔다. 용 후보자는 이날도 의원직 사퇴 생각이 없냐는 질문에 침묵했다.)

Yong's tax-saving abilities have also become a topic of discussion. According to the office of Rep. Kim Geon of the People Power Party, Yong paid approximately 24.73 million won in income tax over the past five years as a lawmaker. From 2021 through last year, Yong received about 108 million won annually in parliamentary salaries, totaling around 550 million won over five years. Additionally, she received roughly 50 million won per year under categories such as legislative activity expenses and special activity expenses, all of which are tax-exempt. Her husband, Mr. Park, who has served as an official in the Basic Income Party, earned a total of 123.66 million won over five years but paid only 1.6 million won in income tax. Accountant Kim Gyeong-yul said, "It appears she carried out tax-saving maneuvers through political donations of at least 16 million won and up to 62 million won per year." (용 후보자의 절세 능력도 화제가 되고 있다. 국민의힘 김건 의원실에 따르면 용 후보자는 국회의원을 지낸 지난 5년간 약 2473만원의 소득세를 냈다. 용 후보자는 2021년부터 지난해까지 국회의원 세비로 매년 약 1억 800만원씩 받았다. 5년 간 약 5억 5000만원이다. 이밖에 입법활동비·특별활동비 등 명목으로 연 5000만원 가량 지급되는데 이는 모두 비과세다. 기본소득당 당직자를 지내온 남편 박모씨는 5년간 총 1억2366만원의 급여를 받고도 소득세로 160만원만 냈다. 김경율 회계사는 “매년 적게는 1600만원, 많게는 6200만원의 정치 자금 기부금을 통해 절세 신공을 벌인 것으로 보인다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Hong Ji-seon, the nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, is known to have purchased an apartment in Sindorim, Guro-gu, Seoul, in May of last year for 1.005 billion won under joint ownership with his spouse, taking out a mortgage of 367 million won and borrowing 170 million won from his mother-in-law. At the time, Hong was serving as deputy mayor of Namyangju, Gyeonggi Province, and was appointed as Vice Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport in December of that year. Rep. Kim Eun-hye of the People Power Party said, "The nominee for Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, nominated by President Lee Jae-myung—who told the public not to take on debt to buy homes—is the very person who bought a house with all-out leverage just a year ago." (한편, 홍지선 국토교통부 장관 후보자가 작년 5월 서울 구로구 신도림에 10억500만원 아파트를 부부 공동명의로 매입하면서 주택담보대출 3억6700만원, 장모에게1억7000만원을 빌린 것으로 알려졌다. 당시 홍 후보자는 경기 남양주 부시장을 지내고 있었고 그해 12월 국토부 차관에 발탁됐다. 김은혜 국민의힘 의원은 “국민에게는 빚내서 집사지 말라던 이재명 대통령이 지명한 국토부 장관 후보자는 불과 1년전 영끌로 집을 샀던 장본인”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Blue House on Hormuz Deployment: "Reviewing Various Options" (靑, 호르무즈 파병 “다양한 옵션 검토”)
item.description:
Blue House on Hormuz Deployment: "Reviewing Various Options" (靑, 호르무즈 파병 “다양한 옵션 검토”)

The Blue House said on the 4th regarding the plan to deploy military forces to the Strait of Hormuz that "we can maneuver within a scope that does not significantly undermine readiness on the Korean Peninsula." A Blue House official, meeting with reporters that day, stated this while saying, "We have repeatedly discussed making a practical contribution to the stability of the Strait of Hormuz, and in fact, a practical contribution includes a military contribution." The official added, "A military contribution can involve participating in combat, but there are also various options such as non-combat roles and search operations." (청와대는 4일 호르무즈 해협에 군 전력을 파병하는 방안에 대해 “한반도 대비 태세에 큰 손상이 있지 않은 범위 내에서 운신(運身)할 수 있다”고 했다. 청와대 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “호르무즈 해협 안정을 위한 실질적 기여에 대해 여러 번 얘기했고, 사실 실질적 기여는 군사적 기여를 포함한다”며 이같이 밝혔다. 이 관계자는 “군사적 기여에는 전투에 참여하는 것도 있으나, 비전투, 수색 등 다양한 옵션이 있다”고 했다.)

The government is known to be reviewing non-combat missions such as maritime surveillance and reconnaissance, mine clearance, and logistical support, rather than direct combat, while responding to the U.S. request. Earlier last month, the government reportedly conveyed to the U.S. side its intention to dispatch non-combat assets, including the Navy's new logistics support ship "Soyang" and P-8A maritime patrol aircraft with submarine detection capabilities, and is consulting on specific details. (정부는 미국 요청에 부응하면서도 직접 전투보다는 해상 감시·정찰, 기뢰 제거, 군수지원 등 비전투 임무를 검토하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 앞서 정부는 지난달 미국 측에 해군의 신형 군수지원함 ‘소양함’, 잠수함 탐지 능력이 있는 P-8A 해상초계기 등 비전투 자산의 파견 의사를 전달하고 구체적인 내용을 협의 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)

The Blue House said regarding whether and when to deploy troops that "nothing has been decided yet." It stated that consultations with the United States, France, the United Kingdom, and others are underway. However, as the Blue House has publicly indicated it is examining readiness on the Korean Peninsula in light of the deployment, there is talk that it has effectively left open the possibility of deployment, considering the U.S.'s continued demands and security-related negotiations between Seoul and Washington. When asked whether the dispatch of military assets to the Strait of Hormuz could be addressed at the upcoming South Korea-France summit in France next week, a Blue House official said, "It is difficult to say there is no possibility." (청와대는 파병 여부, 시기에 대해 “아직 정해진 것은 없다”고 했다. 미국과 프랑스, 영국 등과 관련 협의를 진행하는 단계라고 했다. 하지만 청와대가 공개적으로 파병에 따른 한반도 대비 태세를 살펴보고 있다고 밝힌 것을 두고, 미 측의 지속적인 파병 요구와 한미 간 안보 분야 협상 등을 감안해 사실상 파병 가능성을 열어 둔 것이라는 말이 나왔다. 청와대 관계자는 다음 주 프랑스에서 열리는 한·프 정상회담에서 호르무즈 해협 군사 자산 파견이 다뤄질 수 있느냐는 질문에 “가능성이 없다고 하기는 어렵다”고 했다.)

Parliamentary consent is required for troop deployment. A Blue House official also said, "We are considering it in accordance with domestic legal procedures," adding, "Domestic legal procedures mean consultation with the National Assembly and its consent." The Democratic Party leadership did not issue an official position that day, only saying, "We will gather opinions." However, opposition from some ruling party members and the Rebuilding Korea Party within the broader pro-government camp is expected to lead to friction. (파병을 하려면 국회 동의가 필요하다. 청와대 관계자도 “국내법적인 절차에 따라서도 고려를 하고 있다”며 “국내법 절차라고 하는 것은 국회와의 협의, 국회 동의를 의미한다”고 했다. 민주당 지도부는 이날 공식 입장을 내지 않고 “의견을 수렴해보겠다”고만 했다. 다만 여당 일부와 조국혁신당 등 범여권이 반대하고 있어 진통이 예상된다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Unable to Take a Stance on Troop Dispatch... Pro-Government Bloc Fiercely Objects, "Don't Cross the Line" (파병 입장 못 정하는 민주당… 범여권은 “선 넘지 말라” 강력 반발)
item.description:
Democratic Party Unable to Take a Stance on Troop Dispatch... Pro-Government Bloc Fiercely Objects, "Don't Cross the Line" (파병 입장 못 정하는 민주당… 범여권은 “선 넘지 말라” 강력 반발)

The Blue House's official mention on the 4th that it is reviewing a troop dispatch for stability in the Strait of Hormuz was interpreted as a response to continued public demands for troop deployment from U.S. President Donald Trump and the stalled South Korea-U.S. security negotiations that have made little progress. Although the Blue House initially drew a line saying "nothing has been decided," if an actual dispatch materializes, friction is expected over the handling of a troop dispatch consent motion in the National Assembly. The Democratic Party of Korea issued no official statement on the dispatch that day, while the Fatherland Innovation Party and the Progressive Party clearly stated their opposition. Observations also emerged that the troop dispatch issue could accelerate division within the pro-government bloc. (청와대가 4일 호르무즈 해협 안정을 위한 파병을 검토 중이라고 공식 언급한 건 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령의 공개적인 파병 요구가 계속되고, 좀처럼 앞으로 나아가지 못하는 한미 안보 분야 협상 등을 감안한 것으로 해석됐다. 청와대가 “아무것도 결정된 것은 없다”고 일단 선을 긋기는 했지만, 실제 파병이 현실화하면 국회에서의 파병 동의안 처리 등을 놓고 진통이 예상된다. 더불어민주당은 이날 파병 관련 공식 입장을 내지 않은 가운데 조국혁신당과 진보당은 반대 입장을 분명히 했다. 파병 문제가 대두되면 범여권 분열이 가속화할 수 있다는 관측도 나왔다.)

President Trump said in the middle of last month that he had asked the South Korean president whether Seoul was willing to join efforts to denuclearize Iran, but that they replied, "No thanks!" He also significantly reduced the annual South Korea-U.S. joint military exercises. As President Trump applied public pressure, the Blue House stated that it was "discussing practical and military contributions with the U.S. side, taking into account all factors such as readiness posture on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." (트럼프 대통령은 지난달 중순 “한국 대통령에게 이란의 비핵화 노력에 동참할 의향이 있는지 물었으나, 그들은 ‘사양하겠다!(No thanks!)’고 말했다”면서 연례 한미 연합훈련을 대폭 축소했다. 트럼프 대통령이 공개 압박하자 청와대는 “한반도 대비 태세와 국내법 절차 등 제반 요인을 감안해 실질적, 군사적 기여 방안을 미측과 논의 중”이라고 했다.)

A Blue House official said that day, "President Trump's remarks and our review of (a troop dispatch) are not directly related," adding, "We have been cooperating on (matters related to the dispatch) even before President Trump made those remarks." However, there were also voices within the Blue House acknowledging that "President Trump's public criticism is indeed a burden." (청와대 관계자는 이날 “트럼프 대통령의 말과, 우리가 (파병을) 검토하는 것은 직접적인 관련이 없다”며 “트럼프 대통령의 그 말이 나오기 전부터 (파병 관련 사안을) 협력해 왔다”고 했다. 하지만 청와대 내에서도 “트럼프 대통령의 공개 비난이 부담인 건 사실”이라는 말이 나왔다.)

In the government bloc, some interpreted the Blue House's mention of a troop dispatch as possibly related to security negotiations between South Korea and the U.S. or the prospects of a U.S.-North Korea summit. If the troop dispatch desired by President Trump is carried out, it could have a positive impact on working-level consultations regarding expanding rights to uranium enrichment and reprocessing of spent nuclear fuel, as well as the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines, which the two leaders agreed upon last year. (여권에선 청와대의 파병 언급이 한미 간 안보 분야 협상이나 미·북 회담 가능성과도 관련된 것 아니냐는 해석도 나온다. 트럼프 대통령이 원하는 파병이 이뤄질 경우, 한미 정상이 지난해 합의한 우라늄 농축과 사용 후 핵연료 재처리 권한 확대, 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입 등의 관련 실무 협의에도 긍정적 영향을 줄 수 있다는 것이다.)

A government official said, "Working-level consultations are currently effectively stalled, and while the U.S. side points to delays in investment in the U.S., the fundamental problem is that overall South Korea-U.S. relations are not smooth," adding, "If the troop dispatch President Trump demands is carried out, I believe it will have a positive effect on improving bilateral ties." Another figure said, "At a time when President Trump says he will meet Kim Jong-un, coordination between South Korea and the U.S. is more important than ever," adding, "Strengthening the relationship is necessary even to avoid being sidelined in U.S.-North Korea talks." (정부 관계자는 “현재 실무 협의는 사실상 막힌 상황이고, 미 측이 대미 투자 지연 등을 문제 삼고 있다고 하지만 전체적으로는 한미 관계가 원활하지 않다는 게 근본적 문제”라며 “트럼프 대통령이 요구하는 파병이 이뤄지면 한미 관계 개선에 긍정적 효과가 있을 것으로 본다”고 했다. 다른 인사도 “트럼프 대통령이 김정은을 만나겠다고 하면서 한미 간 공조가 그 어느 때보다 중요한 시점”이라며 “북미 회담에서 패싱을 당하지 않기 위해서라도 관계 강화가 필요하다”고 했다.)

After a Blue House official mentioned the review of a Hormuz dispatch that morning and said there were "various options" for "practical contributions," the Blue House announced through a notice that "nothing has been decided regarding practical contributions." President Lee Jae-myung also reportedly responded, "Nothing has progressed yet," when opposition to the troop dispatch was raised during a meeting with civic group figures that morning. He was also said to have conveyed that stability in Hormuz is necessary for oil supply and other matters, that he is taking the dispatch issue seriously, and that he would give it much thought. (청와대 관계자가 이날 오전 호르무즈 파병 검토를 언급하며 ‘실질적 기여’ 방안에 대해 “다양한 옵션이 있다”고 한 뒤, 청와대는 공지를 통해 “현재 실질적 기여와 관련해 아무 것도 결정된 것이 없다”고 했다. 이재명 대통령도 이날 오전 시민사회단체 인사들과 만난 자리에서 ‘파병 반대’ 의견이 나오자 “아직 진척된 것은 없다”고 답했다고 한다. 그러면서도 원유 수급 등에서 호르무즈 안정은 필요하다며 파병 문제에 대해선 심각하게 보고 있고 많이 고민하겠다는 취지로 말했다고 한다.)

Park Sung-joon, the Democratic Party's senior spokesperson, only said in response to questions about the dispatch that day, "We will proceed after sufficiently collecting opinions." It was said to be a reaction mindful of backlash from the government bloc's support base. Jin Sung-joon, a Democratic Party lawmaker who chairs the National Assembly's Defense Committee, said in a phone call with this newspaper, "If the government requests consent for a troop dispatch, we will comprehensively review various factors and decide then," adding, "There are also realistically necessary aspects, such as securely securing oil shipping routes, so (the opposition stance within the government bloc) could shift somewhat." (민주당 박성준 수석대변인은 이날 파병 관련 질문에 “의견을 충분히 수렴해 진행할 것”이라고만 했다. 여권 지지층 반발을 의식한 반응이라는 말이 나왔다. 민주당 소속인 진성준 국회 국방위원장은 본지 통화에서 “정부가 파병 동의를 요구하면 그때 여러 가지를 종합적으로 검토해 판단하겠다”면서 “원유 수송로를 안전하게 확보하는 문제 등 현실적으로 필요한 부분도 있어서 (여권 내 반대 입장은) 좀 달라질 수 있다고 본다”고 했다.)

However, when lawmakers from the People Power Party expressed support for a troop dispatch last March, lawmakers from the Democratic Party pushed back with remarks such as "They should volunteer with their own children as the first dispatch unit" (Lawmaker Hwang Myung-sun) and "There is no justification under the Constitution, international law, or the mutual defense treaty" (Lawmaker Boo Seung-chan). That day, Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Ki-heon wrote on Facebook, "If a request for consent to a troop dispatch comes to the National Assembly, I will not agree to a Hormuz dispatch in order to protect national interests and constitutional values." (하지만 지난 3월 국민의힘 측에서 파병 찬성 의견이 나왔을 때, 민주당에서는 “본인들이 먼저 자녀와 함께 선발대로 자원하라”(황명선 의원), “헌법, 국제법, 동맹 상호방위 조약상의 명분이 없다”(부승찬 의원) 등 반발이 나왔다. 이날 민주당 이기헌 의원은 페이스북에 “국회에 파병 동의 요청이 오면 국익과 헌법 가치를 수호하기 위해 호르무즈 파병에 동의하지 않을 것”이라고 했다.)

The Fatherland Innovation Party and the Progressive Party announced their opposition to the troop dispatch. Cho Kuk, head of the Fatherland Innovation Party's Innovation Policy Research Institute, cited Article 5, Clause 1 of the Constitution on Facebook that day, stating, "The Republic of Korea renounces aggressive wars." Kim Joon-hyung, the Fatherland Innovation Party's floor leader and former president of the Korea National Diplomatic Academy, said, "A troop dispatch is a line that must never be crossed under any circumstances," adding, "Why on earth should South Korea be reviewing a troop dispatch for this illegal war of aggression?" Kim Jong-hoon, leader of the Progressive Party, also said, "The troop dispatch is not something that can be brushed aside by drawing a line saying 'nothing has been decided,'" and "President Lee must clearly declare that he will not send troops." Representative Kim also said, "We must reveal who on earth is reviewing and pushing such a perilous troop dispatch, and the circumstances and those responsible." Within the government bloc, concerns were raised that "the troop dispatch issue could become a new fuse leading to division within the pro-government bloc." (조국혁신당과 진보당은 파병 반대 입장을 밝혔다. 조국 조국혁신당 혁신정책연구원장은 이날 페이스북에 헌법 5조 1항을 인용해 “대한민국은 침략적 전쟁을 부인한다”고 했다. 국립외교원 원장을 지낸 김준형 조국혁신당 원내대표는 “파병은 어떤 경우에도 넘어서는 안 될 선”이라며 “도대체 왜 이 불법적인 침략 전쟁에 대한민국이 파병을 검토해야 하나”라고 했다. 김종훈 진보당 대표도 “파병은 ‘결정된 바 없다’는 선 긋기로 넘어갈 일이 아니다”라며 “이 대통령이 파병하지 않겠다고 분명히 선언해야 한다”고 했다. 김 대표는 “도대체 누가 이런 위험천만한 파병을 검토하고 추진하는지, 그 경위와 책임자를 밝혀야 한다”고도 했다. 여권 내에서는 “파병 문제가 범여권 분열로 이어지는 새로운 뇌관이 될 수 있다”는 우려가 나왔다.)

item.title: Foreign Minister Cho Visits Nepal in Surprise Trip... Mobilizing Full Efforts for Search and Relief amid 'Flood Damage' (조현 외교장관, 네팔 전격 방문… ‘홍수 피해’ 수색·구호 총력 대응)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Visits Nepal in Surprise Trip... Mobilizing Full Efforts for Search and Relief amid 'Flood Damage' (조현 외교장관, 네팔 전격 방문… ‘홍수 피해’ 수색·구호 총력 대응)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul will depart for Nepal on the 5th to visit the site of the flood disaster in Nepal, personally overseeing the search and rescue operations for our nationals and encouraging local response personnel. (조현 외교부 장관이 네팔 홍수 참사 현장을 찾아 우리 국민 수색·구조 상황을 직접 챙기고 현지 대응 인력을 격려하기 위해 5일 네팔로 출국한다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 5th that Minister Cho will visit Nepal for three days and two nights from the 5th to the 7th to hold a Korea-Nepal foreign ministers' meeting and review on-site response activities. This visit follows the government's directive to spare no effort in rescue operations for our nationals and the protection of overseas citizens in the wake of recent flood damage at local hydropower plant construction sites in Nepal. (외교부는 5일 조 장관이 이날부터 7일까지 2박 3일간 네팔을 방문해 한·네팔 외교장관 회담 및 현지 대응 활동 점검에 나선다고 밝혔다. 이번 방문은 최근 네팔 현지 수력발전소 건설 현장 등에서 발생한 홍수 피해로 인한 우리 국민 구조 작업과 재외 국민 보호에 총력을 기울이라는 정부 방침에 따른 조치다.)

Minister Cho plans to hold talks with Nepal's foreign minister on-site. Through these talks, he intends to officially request the active cooperation and allocation of resources from the local government for the search and rescue operations of our nationals. He will also visit the Quick Response Team and the Korea Disaster Relief Team (KDRT), which are carrying out search, rescue, and humanitarian aid activities on the ground, to assess the situation. (조 장관은 현지에서 네팔 외교장관과 회담을 할 예정이다. 이를 통해 우리 국민 수색 및 구조 작업에 대한 현지 정부의 적극적인 협조와 자원 투입을 공식 요청한다는 방침이다. 또 현지에서 수색·구조 및 인도적 지원 활동을 펼치고 있는 신속대응팀과 해외긴급구호대(KDRT)를 직접 찾아 현장 상황을 점검한다.)

Minister Cho will meet with the families of our nationals who have lost contact while staying in the area to offer his condolences, and will discuss on-site damage conditions and safety measures during meetings with officials from Korean companies operating there. Despite adverse conditions such as washed-out roads and communication failures, the government plans to fully mobilize diplomatic channels and emergency relief teams to ensure the swift safe return of our nationals and to provide prompt support for recovery efforts. (조 장관은 현지에 체류 중인 우리 국민 연락두절자 가족들을 만나 위로의 뜻을 전하고, 현지 진출 한국 기업 관계자들과 면담을 통해 현장 피해 상황 및 안전 대책을 논의한다. 정부는 현지의 유실된 도로와 통신 장애 등 악조건 속에서도 외교 채널과 긴급구호대를 총가동해 우리 국민의 조속한 생환 및 신속한 복구 지원에 만전을 기할 방침이다.)

item.title: Despite Claiming 'Party-Government Unity'... Discord Over Real Estate, Second-Term Cabinet Reshuffle, and Mega Special Zones (‘당정 일치’ 내세웠지만… 부동산, 2기 개각, 메가특구 엇박자)
item.description:
Despite Claiming 'Party-Government Unity'... Discord Over Real Estate, Second-Term Cabinet Reshuffle, and Mega Special Zones (‘당정 일치’ 내세웠지만… 부동산, 2기 개각, 메가특구 엇박자)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the government have recently been at odds over policy directions, including real estate tax reform proposals and legislative support for three major mega projects. Even regarding the second-term cabinet reshuffle announced recently by President Lee Jae-myung, no unified voice has emerged from the ruling party. The mainstream of the Democratic Party has argued that during the previous leadership under Chung Chung-rae, the "Myeong-Cheong War" and "party-presidential conflict" drove down approval ratings for both the president and the ruling party. However, nearly three weeks have passed since the leadership under Kim Min-seok, who is close to the president, launched under the banner of "party-government unity," yet tensions between the party and the government persist, and the decline in approval ratings has not stopped. <<> When asked on SBS Radio on the 4th whether the ruling party could further ease real estate taxes and whether it was actually under review, Cheong Wa Dae's Senior Secretary for Economic Growth Ha Jun-kyung replied, "I think the proposals the party made earlier may have been distorted." This denied the possibility raised within the Democratic Party of additional revisions to the government's plan. Secretary Ha emphasized, "The version the government announced at the Cabinet meeting after minor adjustments fully reflects what was discussed with the ruling party." <<> Originally, the government announced a tax reform plan that would distinguish between actual residents and non-residents even among single-homeowners, imposing heavier comprehensive real estate taxes and capital gains taxes on non-residents. After pushback from the Democratic Party, some parts were revised and passed through the Cabinet meeting. However, the differential treatment between actual residents and non-residents, which the Democratic Party had requested to be removed, was retained with respect to capital gains taxes. As a result, once the government's plan arrived at the National Assembly on the 3rd, lawmakers from the ruling party, particularly those representing the Seoul metropolitan area, began calling for further revisions, saying, "This level of change won't calm the angry public sentiment over real estate." It is known that the party and the government are currently discussing the tax reform plan to be brought to the plenary session through behind-the-scenes consultations, but their differences have not been narrowed. A source in the Democratic Party's leadership said, "We strongly urged the government to revise it, but the government is also being stubborn." <<> Discord between the party and the government also emerges over other government policies. The government is seeking to apply an exception to the 52-hour workweek system for the Honam semiconductor mega special zone, but at the party-government consultation that day, the relevant bill was not even discussed. Rep. Yoo Dong-soo, chairman of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, said, "That topic is sensitive, so we postponed the discussion." Democratic Party members of the National Assembly's Education Committee are also opposing the government's plan to reform the current system, which automatically allocates 20.79% of national tax revenue to the local education grant, into a method that reflects the school-age population and economic conditions. <<> A temperature difference between Cheong Wa Dae and the Democratic Party is also detectable regarding the president's appointments. Cheong Wa Dae maintains the position of "watching the confirmation hearings" despite various allegations against the nominees. Within the Democratic Party, it is known that while there is a willingness to defend Justice Minister nominee Kim Seung-won, arguments are emerging regarding Gender Equality and Family Minister nominee Yong Hye-in that "at this point, shouldn't she step down on her own?" One senior lawmaker said, "It seems the second-term cabinet reshuffle was carried out as a card to reverse the approval rating decline, but it is instead turning into a risk. I can't understand why Cheong Wa Dae would try to appoint someone who led the push to drop charges as justice minister, and it's especially strange that they nominated nominee Yong, who, despite being born in 1990, could be seen as part of the privileged class." Within the ruling party, there is also talk of "How on earth is personnel vetting being done?" Typically, the presidential chief of staff for personnel and the chief of staff for civil affairs handle recommendations and vetting. A key Democratic Party official said, "Some ministers only learned of their replacement through the presidential office's announcement that day. What on earth is the political affairs office doing?" At the time of the announcement, Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yoon-cheol, who was about to depart for the United States to attend a G20 meeting, was caught off guard at the airport upon learning of his replacement. <<> Approval ratings for the president and the ruling party are plunging. In a Gallup Korea survey conducted via wireless telephone interviews on the 1st through the 3rd, President Lee's approval rating was 40%, the lowest since taking office. That marks a 27-percentage-point drop from 67% in the last week of April, within just over four months. Over the same period, approval for the Democratic Party also fell from 48% to 38%. The top reason cited for negative assessments was "real estate policy" at 23%, followed by "economy and livelihoods" at 11%, "personnel" at 9%, and "moral issues and evasion of own trial" at 6% (for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (더불어민주당과 정부가 최근 부동산 세제 개편안, 3대 메가 프로젝트 지원 법안 등 정책 방향을 두고 엇박자를 내고 있다. 최근 이재명 대통령이 발표한 2기 개각에 대해서도 여당에서 일치된 목소리가 나오지 않고 있다. 민주당 주류는 전임 정청래 지도부 시절 ‘명청 대전’ ‘당청 갈등’으로 인해 대통령과 여당 지지율이 하락했다고 주장해 왔다. 하지만 대통령과 가까운 김민석 지도부가 “당정 일치”를 앞세워 출범한 지 3주 가까이 지났지만 당정 간 긴장 관계가 이어지며, 지지율 하락세가 멈추지 않고 있다.)

item.title: Seo Young-kyo: "No Noose of Suspended Indictment for Cases Requiring No-Charge Verdicts," Shielding Kim Seung-won (서영교 “무혐의 사건에 기소유예 올가미 안돼” 김승원 감싸기)
item.description:
Seo Young-kyo: "No Noose of Suspended Indictment for Cases Requiring No-Charge Verdicts," Shielding Kim Seung-won (서영교 “무혐의 사건에 기소유예 올가미 안돼” 김승원 감싸기)

Seo Young-kyo, chair of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, argued on the 5th that "cases that should be judged as no charges must not be subjected to the noose of a suspended indictment, forcing the party involved to go so far as filing a constitutional complaint." She cited as grounds the fact that the acceptance rate of constitutional complaints seeking the revocation of prosecutorial suspended indictment dispositions has reached approximately 16.9% over the past six years. (서영교 국회 법제사법위원장이 “무혐의로 판단해야 할 사건에 기소유예라는 올가미를 씌워 당사자가 헌법소원까지 제기하게 만드는 일은 없어야 한다”고 5일 주장했다. ‘검찰의 기소유예 처분을 취소해달라’는 헌법소원 사건의 인용률이 지난 6년간 약 16.9%에 달한다는 것을 근거로 들었다.)

According to the "Annual Status of Constitutional Complaints for Revocation of Suspended Indictment Dispositions" submitted by the Constitutional Court to Rep. Seo, the court ruled in favor of 249 (16.9%) out of a total of 1,476 constitutional complaints seeking revocation of suspended indictments from 2020 to 2025. A suspended indictment refers to a situation where a suspect's charges are acknowledged, but the prosecutor chooses not to bring the suspect to trial after considering various circumstances. While the individual may avoid criminal punishment, the investigative agency has determined that a crime was established, so the legitimacy of the disposition can be challenged through a constitutional complaint. (헌법재판소가 서 의원에게 제출한 ‘연도별 기소유예 처분 취소 헌법소원 사건 현황’에 따르면 헌재는 2020년부터 2025년까지 6년간 기소유예 취소 헌법소원 총 1476건 중 249건(16.9%)을 인용 처리했다. 기소유예는 혐의가 인정되지만 검사가 여러 정황을 고려해 피의자를 재판에 넘기지 않는 것을 말한다. 형사처벌은 면할 수 있지만 수사기관이 죄가 성립한다고 판단한 것이어서 헌법소원으로 처분의 정당성을 따질 수 있다.)

The annual acceptance rates were 16.0% in 2021, 12.3% in 2022, 21.6% in 2023, and 18.1% in 2024. Chair Seo stated, "Over the past six years, the acceptance rate for constitutional complaints against prosecutorial revocation of suspended indictments was 10.7% even in the lowest year, and reached as high as 23.8% in the highest year," adding, "Cases that should be judged as no charges must not be subjected to the noose of a suspended indictment, forcing the party involved to file a constitutional complaint." (연도별 인용률은 2021년 16.0%, 2022년 12.3%, 2023년 21.6%, 2024년 18.1% 등이었다. 서 위원장은 “최근 6년간 검찰의 기소유예 취소 처분에 대한 헌법소원 인용률은 가장 낮은 해에도 10.7%였고, 가장 높은 해에는 무려 23.8%에 달했다”며 “무혐의로 판단해야 할 사건에 기소유예라는 올가미를 씌워 당사자가 헌법소원까지 제기하게 만드는 일은 없어야 한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Seo's criticism of the prosecution's inappropriate practice of suspended indictments appears to be a bid to provide side support for Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice. Kim had received a suspended indictment on charges of involvement in lobbying for COVID-19 treatments and subsequently filed a constitutional complaint in May of last year. Rep. Seo's position is that the suspended indictment against Kim was likewise unjust. (서 의원이 검찰의 부적절한 기소유예 관행을 지적한 것은 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자를 측면 지원하기 위한 것으로 보인다. 김 후보자는 코로나19 치료제 로비에 관여했다는 혐의로 기소유예 처분을 받은 뒤 지난해 5월 헌법소원을 제기한 바 있다. 김 후보자에 대한 기소유예 처분 역시 옳지 못하다는 게 서 의원의 입장이다.)

The two have worked in tandem at the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, holding the key positions of chair and ruling party floor secretary, respectively. On September 1 of last year, during the National Assembly's opening ceremony, media cameras captured the moment when Kim sent a Telegram message to Chair Seo explaining his allegations and saying, "Chair, I apologize." (두 사람은 국회 법사위에서 각각 위원장과 여당 간사라는 핵심 직책을 맡아 호흡을 맞춰왔다. 지난 9월 1일 국회 개회식 도중, 김 후보자가 서 위원장에게 자신의 의혹을 해명하며 “위원장님 송구합니다”라는 텔레그램 메시지를 보내는 장면이 언론사 카메라에 포착되기도 했다.)

item.title: Kim Seung-won Called It a "Public-Interest Complaint"... "The Moment It's Approved, Billions" (‘공익 민원’이라던 김승원… “승인되는 순간 수천억”)
item.description:
Kim Seung-won Called It a "Public-Interest Complaint"... "The Moment It's Approved, Billions" (‘공익 민원’이라던 김승원… “승인되는 순간 수천억”)

A transcript was released on the 4th containing phone calls between Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice who has faced allegations of "COVID-19 drug lobbying," and a broker surnamed Yang, in which Kim said, "The moment the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety approves (the clinical trial), you can make tens of billions of won outright." Five days after that call, the nominee phoned then-Commissioner of the Food and Drug Safety, Kim Gang-lip, asking for "swift handling." The opposition party stated, "The nominee was already aware beforehand that his request call was tied to a massive 'COVID business.'" (‘코로나 신약 로비’ 의혹이 제기된 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 브로커 양모씨와 전화 통화에서 “식품의약품안전처 (임상시험이) 승인되는 순간 완전히 수천억 원을 벌 수 있는 거잖아”라고 말하는 내용이 담긴 녹취록이 4일 공개됐다. 김 후보자는 통화 5일 뒤 당시 김강립 식약처장에게 “빠른 처리”를 부탁하는 전화를 걸었다. 야당은 “김 후보자가 자신의 청탁 전화에 막대한 ‘코로나 비즈니스’가 얽혀 있음을 사전에 인지하고 있었던 것”이라고 했다.)

According to the transcript released that day by independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, on October 7, 2021, Kim told Yang during their call, "The moment the food and drug authority approves it, you can make billions of won, which is why there is fierce lobbying (among pharmaceutical companies)," adding, "I need to hear the explanation, so send me the materials by email." Later that same day, Yang emailed Kim the data on the drug development status, and five days after that, Kim contacted Commissioner Kim, saying, "I ask that you have the working-level staff handle (the clinical trial approval) quickly." (무소속 한동훈 의원이 이날 공개한 녹취록에 따르면, 2021년 10월 7일 김 후보자는 양씨와의 통화에서 “식약처 승인되는 순간 수천억 원을 벌 수 있고, 그래서 (제약사 간) 치열한 로비가 있다”며 “설명을 들어봐야 하니까 메일로 자료 보내달라”고 말했다. 이후 같은 날 양씨는 김 후보자에게 신약 개발 현황 자료를 이메일로 보냈고, 이로부터 닷새 뒤 김 후보자는 김 처장에게 “실무자들이 빠르게 (임상시험 승인을) 처리할 수 있도록 부탁드린다”고 연락했다.)

In an earlier call on September 14, Yang told Kim, "(Once the food and drug authority grants approval), that company becomes a COVID company, and it would also be good for you, oppa, when you campaign next year." Referring to Kang, the founder of Genecell, Yang said, "If he becomes the head of a listed company and his funding becomes smooth, he seems like someone who could be a strength to you." (이보다 앞선 9월 14일 통화에서 양씨는 김 후보자에게 “(식약처 승인이 이뤄지면) 그 회사가 코로나 회사가 되고, 내년 오빠 선거할 때 좋기도 하다”고 했다. 제넨셀 설립자인 강모씨를 가리켜 “상장사 대표가 되어 자금 융통도 원활해지면 오빠에게 힘이 될 것 같은 사람”이라고 했다.)

Han claimed that the Seoul Western District Prosecutors' Office, which was investigating the Genecell allegations, summoned and questioned Kim in August 2024 on charges of promising to accept a bribe for influence-peddling, then reported to the Supreme Prosecutors' Office that it would seek an eight-month prison sentence, but the recommendation was ignored. According to the "sentencing recommendation plan report" released by Han, the Seoul Western District Prosecutors' Office stated regarding Kim: "He conveyed a request to Commissioner Kim Gang-lip for approval of the clinical trial for the COVID-19 treatment developed by Genecell, and in return, agreed to receive 5 million won under the guise of a donation." However, the prosecution leadership at the time issued a suspended indictment, taking into account that the 5 million won donation had not actually been delivered to Kim. (한 의원은 제넨셀 의혹을 수사하던 서울서부지검이 2024년 8월 김 후보자를 알선 뇌물 약속 혐의로 소환 조사한 뒤 징역 8개월을 구형하겠다고 대검에 보고했으나 묵살됐다고 주장했다. 한 의원이 공개한 ‘구형 계획 보고서’에 따르면 서울서부지검은 김 후보자에 대해 “김강립 식약처장에게 제넨셀이 개발한 코로나 치료제 임상시험 승인 청탁을 전달하고, 그 대가로 후원금 명목 500만원을 수수하기로 약속했다”고 돼있다. 그러나 당시 검찰 지휘부는 후원금 500만원이 김 후보자에게 실제로 전달되지는 않았다는 점 등을 고려해 기소유예 처분했다.)

In response to these allegations, Kim's side stated, "It is an exception to improper solicitation for an elected public official to convey a third party's grievance complaint for public-interest purposes," adding, "Judging that the grievance over the delayed clinical trial process had public interest, he conveyed it to the Commissioner of the Food and Drug Safety." In response, Han said, "Is it what the Democratic Party calls public interest for Kim to reply, 'You can make billions of won,' to a request from a broker from the entertainment industry who called him 'oppa'?" The ruling and opposition parties have agreed to hold a confirmation hearing for Kim on the 15th. (김 후보자 측은 이 같은 의혹에 대해 “선출직 공직자가 공익적 목적으로 제3자의 고충 민원을 전달하는 행위는 부정 청탁의 예외”라며 “임상시험 절차가 지연되는 고충 민원에 공익성이 있다는 판단으로 식약처장에게 전달했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 대해 한 의원은 “자신을 오빠라고 불렀던 유흥업소 출신 브로커 요청에 김 후보자가 ‘수천억 원 벌 수 있다’고 답하는 것이 민주당이 말하는 공익인가”라고 했다. 여야는 15일 김 후보자에 대한 인사청문회를 열기로 했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Twice as Fast as Average... 'Kim Seung-won Lobby Allegation' Genencell Received FDA Approval in Just 33 Days ([단독]평균보다 2배 빨랐다… ‘김승원 로비 의혹’ 제넨셀, 33일 만에 식약처 승인)
item.description:
Data released on the 5th shows that the clinical trial approval for Genencell, the pharmaceutical company at the center of the 'lobbying allegations' involving Kim Seung-won, nominee for Minister of Justice, was more than twice as fast as other new-substance COVID-19 treatments. The opposition party has pointed out that "from the perspective of nominee Kim, who directly requested 'fast approval' from the Commissioner of the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, this amounts to a successful lobbying effort." (김승원 법무부 장관 후보자와 관련된 ‘로비 의혹’ 제약사 제넨셀의 임상 승인 속도가 다른 신(新)물질 코로나 치료제보다 2배 이상 빨랐던 것으로 5일 나타났다. 야당에서는 “식품의약품안전처장에게 직접 ‘빠른 승인’을 요구했던 김 후보자의 입장에서 본다면 성공한 로비였던 셈”이라는 지적이 나왔다.)

◇ Average 71 Days for 'New Substance Clinical Trials,' Genencell Takes 33 (◇‘신물질 임상’ 평균 71일, 제넨셀은 33일)

According to the 'Status of COVID-19 Treatment Clinical Trial Approvals' submitted by the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS) to the office of Rep. Han Ji-ah of the People Power Party, 21 new-substance-based COVID-19 treatment development projects between 2020 and 2022 took an average of 71 days to receive approval. In contrast, Genencell, despite being under the same new-substance-based conditions, took only 33 days—more than twice as fast. (국민의힘 한지아 의원실이 식약처에서 제출받은 ‘코로나 치료제 임상시험 승인 현황’에 따르면 2020~2022년 사이 신물질 기반 코로나 치료제 개발 21건이 승인을 받는 데 평균 71일 걸렸다. 반면 제넨셀은 같은 신물질 기반 조건인데도 33일이 걸렸다. 승인 속도가 2배 이상 빨랐던 셈이다.)

During the same period, the MFDS granted approvals for 45 COVID-19 treatment clinical trials. Among these, 24 were drug repurposing cases that added efficacy to already approved pharmaceuticals, while 21 cases, including Genencell, were submitted for clinical trial approval as new substances. (같은 기간 식약처는 코로나 치료제 임상시험 승인을 45건 허가했다. 이 가운데 기존 허가 의약품의 효능을 추가하는 약물 재창출이 24건, 신물질로 임상시험 승인 접수에 나선 경우는 제넨셀을 포함해서 21건이었다.)

Typically, drug repurposing—since the drugs have already been administered to patients and safety data is available—takes less time for MFDS approval than new substances. Indeed, the average approval period for drug-repurposing COVID-19 treatment clinical trials submitted to the MFDS between 2020 and 2022 was 38.7 days, faster than the 71.6 days for new substances. Yet Genencell, which submitted its 'Dangphalsu (camellia) extract' as a new substance, was approved in 33 days—even surpassing the average approval period for drug repurposing. (통상적으로 약물 재창출은 이미 환자에게 투여되어 부작용 데이터가 확보된 만큼 통상적으로 식약처 승인까지 걸리는 기간이 신물질보다 짧다. 실제 2020~2022년 식약처에 접수된 약물 재창출 방식의 코로나 치료제 임상시험 평균 승인 기간은 38.7일로 신물질(71.6일)보다 빨랐다. 그런데 신물질 ‘담팔수 추출물’로 접수에 나섰던 제넨셀(33일)은 약물 재창출의 평균 승인 기간마저 앞지르는 수준이었다.)

◇ Genencell Received 14 Requests for Supplementation from MFDS (◇제넨셀, 식약처 보완 요구만 14건)

This has led to suspicions, mainly from the opposition, that "this is hard to view as a normal approval speed." It is argued that for a small pharmaceutical company developing a new substance, this was exceptionally fast approval. Moreover, on September 30, 2021, Genencell had received a request from the MFDS to supplement a total of 14 items. Nevertheless, Genencell secured MFDS approval just over a month later. The prosecution has determined that nominee Kim's request influenced this outcome. (이 때문에 야당을 중심으로 “정상적인 승인 속도로 보기 어렵다”는 의혹이 제기되고 있다. 신물질 기반인 데다 규모가 작은 제약업체로는 이례적으로 빠른 승인이 이뤄졌다는 것이다. 더구나 제넨셀은 2021년 9월 30일 식약처 측으로부터 도합 14개 항목에 대해서 보완하라는 요구를 받은 상태였다. 그럼에도 제넨셀은 한 달여 만에 식약처 승인을 받아낸 것이다. 검찰은 여기에 김 후보자의 청탁이 영향을 미친 것으로 판단했다.)

According to the indictment, after receiving the MFDS notification for supplementing 14 items, Genencell founder Kang (surname) requested broker Yang (surname), saying, "Please work through political figures to ensure prompt approval." In response, Yang asked nominee Kim, with whom he was close, to "help because the MFDS clinical trial plan approval (for Genencell) is being delayed." On October 12, Kim then asked then-MFDS Commissioner Kim Gang-rip, "Please ask the responsible officials to handle it quickly." Commissioner Kim Gang-rip replied, "Congressman, I have relayed the Genencell case you are concerned about to the working-level staff to ensure it is well taken care of." Two weeks later, Genencell received MFDS approval. (공소장에 따르면 식약처의 14개 항목 보완 통보 이후 제넨셀 설립자 강모씨는 브로커 양씨에게 “정치권 인사를 통해 조속한 승인이 이뤄지도록 힘써 달라”는 취지로 요청했다. 이에 양씨는 가깝게 지내던 김 후보자에게 “(제넨셀에 대한) 식약처 임상시험 계획 승인이 늦어지고 있으니 도와달라”고 청탁했고, 김 후보자는 10월 12일 김강립 당시 식약처장에게 “담당 실무자들이 빠르게 처리할 수 있도록 부탁드린다”고 했다. 김강립 처장은 “의원님, 염려해주신 제넨셀 건은 잘 챙기도록 실무진에게 전달했다”고 답장했다. 이로부터 2주 만에 제넨셀은 식약처 승인을 받아 냈다.)

◇ Submission of Falsified Data with 'Hamster Deaths' Removed (◇‘햄스터 사망’ 삭제한 거짓 자료 제출)

During the trial, it was revealed that Genencell submitted falsified data to the MFDS, with cases of suspected side effects—such as hamsters dying in animal tests—deleted. Kang, indicted on charges of breach of trust, was sentenced in the first trial in December 2024 to three years in prison, suspended for five years. Nominee Kim, who was investigated on charges of promising bribes for mediation, received a suspended indictment. A suspended indictment means the charges are acknowledged, but prosecution is postponed. (재판 과정에서 제넨셀은 식약처에 동물실험에서 햄스터가 죽는 부작용 의심 사례 등이 삭제된 거짓 자료를 제출한 것으로 나타났다. 배임 등의 혐의로 기소된 강씨는 2024년 12월 1심에서 징역 3년, 집행유예 5년을 선고받았다. 알선 뇌물 약속 혐의로 조사받았던 김 후보자에게는 기소유예 처분이 내려졌다. 기소유예는 혐의가 인정되지만 공소 제기를 미루는 처분이다.)

Regarding the COVID-19 new drug lobbying allegations, nominee Kim stated, "I called the MFDS Commissioner to relay a public-interest complaint about concerns that the clinical trial process for the treatment might be unjustly delayed," and added, "I have filed a constitutional complaint with the Constitutional Court against the unfair suspended indictment." (김 후보자는 코로나 신약 로비 의혹과 관련해 “치료제 임상시험 절차가 부당하게 지연될 우려가 있다는 공익 민원을 전달하기 위해 식약처장에게 전화했던 것”이라며 “부당한 기소유예 처분에 대해 헌법재판소에 헌법소원을 제기했다”고 밝혔다.)

In response, Rep. Han Ji-ah said, "Regarding the allegations of nominee Kim's lobbying for the COVID-19 drug, the MFDS must clearly explain the circumstances and review basis behind the unusually fast approval of Genencell," and "As this involves the lives and safety of the public, we will thoroughly scrutinize it during the parliamentary audit." (이에 대해 한지아 의원은 “김 후보자의 코로나 신약 로비 의혹과 관련해 식약처는 제넨셀의 승인이 이례적으로 빠르게 이뤄진 경위와 심사 근거를 명확히 밝혀야 한다”며 “국민의 생명과 안전이 걸린 사안인 만큼 국정감사에서 철저히 검증할 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "Little brother, missing you so much I'm tearing up" — Full transcript of phone calls between Kim Seung-won and a broker released (“동생, 보고 싶어 눈물이 나네” 김승원·브로커 통화 녹취록 풀렸다)
item.description:
Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon on the 5th rebutted claims by Kim Seung-won, the nominee for Minister of Justice, that a photo taken in February 2022 with a broker identified as Yang, who is linked to the so-called "new drug influence-peddling allegations," and the judge in charge of the arrest warrant, was a "coincidental meeting," calling it "a blatant lie." Han wrote on Facebook that day, "Is it true that you 'coincidentally' ran into Yang around February 2022?" and released the contents of a phone call between Kim and broker Yang on February 9, 2022. (한동훈 무소속 의원이 5일 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자가 이른바 ‘신약 청탁 의혹’에 연루된 브로커 양모 씨, 영장 담당 판사와 2022년 2월 찍은 사진을 두고 “우연히 만났다”고 해명한 데 대해 “새빨간 거짓말”이라고 반박했다. 한 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “2022년 2월경 양씨를 ‘우연히’ 마주친 게 맞느냐”고 적은 뒤 2022년 2월 9일 김 후보자와 브로커 양씨의 전화 통화 내용을 공개했다.)

According to the recorded transcript released by Han, Kim referred to Yang as "little brother" and said, "I'm tearing up because I miss you." Yang replied, "What? Should I run over now? I'll run over right now — where are you?" and Kim answered, "Yeouido." Yang then asked, "I'm in Hanam — it'll take an hour to get there, is that okay?" and Kim responded, "Sure, sure." Yang told Kim, "Because I'm in Hanam, it takes an hour to get to Yeouido." (한 의원이 공개한 녹취록에 따르면 김 후보자는 양씨를 ‘동생’이라고 부르며 “보고 싶어서 눈물이 나네”라고 했다. 이에 양씨가 “어떻게, 지금 달려가?, 지금 달려갈게 어디야”라고 하자, “여의도”라고 답했다. 이어 양씨가 “나 하남인데 1시간 후에 도착인데 그래도 돼”라고 물었고, 김 후보자는 “그럼 그럼”이라고 답했다. 양씨는 김 후보자에게 “하남이어서 여의도까지 가는 데 1시간은 걸려”라고 했다.)

When Kim said, "Hold on... We're also in the court personnel rotation season and all," Yang asked, "Oh, is it too long?" and Kim again said, "I'll wait for you here." (김 후보자가 “잠시만... 우리 법원 인사철도 있고 그래서”라고 하자 양씨는 “아 너무 긴가”라고 했고, 김 후보자는 다시 “여기(서) 기다릴게”라고 했다.)

In a follow-up call, Kim told Yang, "It'd be a shame if we only get to see each other for 20 or 30 minutes," and Yang said, "No shame at all — I'm on my way carrying a bunch of stuff, so just hang tight." Kim replied, "Okay, okay, I'll be here." Han questioned regarding the recording: "What was all that stuff the broker Yang brought you on the night of February 9, 2022?" (김 후보자는 이어진 2차 통화에서 양씨에게 “20, 30분밖에 못 보면 아쉽잖아”라고 했고, 양씨는 “안 아쉬워, 일단 물건을 잔뜩 챙겨서 가고 있으니까 일단 있어봐”라고 했다. 김 후보자는 “그래, 그래, 있을게”라고 답했다. 한 의원은 해당 녹취와 관련해 “2022년 2월 9일 밤 브로커 양씨에게 잔뜩 받은 물건이 뭐였느냐”고 반문했다.)

Han also released a transcript from October 2021 in which Yang mentioned Kim while on the phone with another person. Regarding the request for new drug approval, Yang said, "Getting the license cleared is oppa Seung-won's job — he talks to the Food and Drug Safety Commissioner, and today he even asked, 'Should I put pressure on the Ministry of Health and Welfare?'" Yang added, "He always tells me, 'You, XX, you're the antenna, and since donations only come to 5 million won, talk about whatever benefits you — everything moves through you, so you have to do well.'" <<>> Regarding that recording, Han stated, "Kim's point was that since he only receives about 5 million won in donations himself, broker Yang should take a decent cut as the price for Kim lobbying the Food and Drug Safety Commissioner." Han added, "I ask whether enabling a broker to line his pockets is what the Democratic Party calls 'handling public-interest grievances.' The Democratic Party's leader Kim Min-seok said they'd now dodge the question and run away — that attitude itself is the Democratic Party's answer." (한 의원은 2021년 10월 양씨가 다른 사람과 통화 중 김 후보자를 언급한 녹취록도 공개했다. 양씨는 신약 승인 청탁과 관련해 “인허가 푸는 거는 승원 오빠지, 승원 오빠가 식약처장에다가 얘기하고 오늘 또 ‘보건복지부에다가 푸시 해줄까’ 그러는데”라고 했다. 이어 “항상 나보고 ‘XX’이 너가 안테나가 돼서 후원금도 500만원밖에 안 되니까 너 잘되는 걸로 얘기해라, 뭐든 ‘너가 잘돼야지, 너보고 다 움직이는 건데”라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party of Korea responded that day, saying, "The reckless allegations against Minister of Justice nominee Kim Seung-won have crossed the line," and argued, "The People Power Party deciding on a conclusion before the confirmation hearing even begins is not vetting — it's nothing but a political attack." (해당 녹취와 관련해 한 의원은 “김 후보자가 자기가 후원금 받아봐야 500만원밖에 안 되니까 자기가 식약처장에 로비해 준 대가를 브로커 양씨가 충분히 챙기라는 취지”라고 했다. 한 의원은 “브로커에게 한몫 잡게 해 주는 것이 민주당이 말하는 ‘공익 민원’인지 묻는다”며 “이제 제 질문에 답 안 하고 도망가겠다고 김민석 민주당 당대표가 말하던데, 그런 태도가 민주당의 답”이라고 했다.)

Kim Seong-hoe, the Democratic Party's chief deputy spokesperson for floor strategy, said in a written briefing that day: "The allegations raised by the People Power Party are nothing new. This is a matter already investigated comprehensively by the prosecution under the Yoon Suk Yeol government over a long period. All available means, including raids and summons for questioning, were mobilized, but in the end they failed to indict. Are they now denying the conclusions of the prosecution they themselves directed?" (더불어민주당은 이날 “김승원 법무부 장관 후보자에 대한 무분별한 의혹 제기가 도를 넘었다”며 “국민의힘이 청문회 시작 전부터 결론을 정해 놓고 몰아가는 것은 검증이 아니라 정치 공세에 불과하다”고 반박했다.)

Kim, a former judge, had previously been investigated on suspicion of receiving a request through a broker in 2021 from Genencell, a COVID-19 treatment company, and asking the then Food and Drug Safety Commissioner to approve the clinical trial of the treatment. However, in December 2024, the prosecution handed down a suspension of indictment against Kim.
